displayTitle: Solo: A Star Wars Story Look and Find
synopsis: Solo: A Star Wars Story Look and Find is a children's activity book based on the film Solo: Join Han Solo and his friends, old and new, as you search for hidden treasures - and dangers - in 8 beautifully illustrated scenes from Solo: A Star Wars Story. Then blast to the back of the book for even more Look & Find challenges.A Star Wars Story.
title: Solo: A Star Wars Story Look and Find
